heading: ## Scope
expected: Make production `merge-back` graph loading honor each parent epic's current durable worktree-location branch, prefetch the child and immediate-epic nodes needed by its synchronous lineage lookups, and keep numeric issue identity separate from opaque branch authority. Preserve canonical `feature/epic/<N>` fallback only when the parent has no recorded branch, and propagate malformed, ambiguous, or missing graph authority as a fail-closed error before any Git mutation.
replacement: Make production `merge-back` graph loading honor each parent epic's current durable worktree-location branch, prefetch the child and immediate-epic nodes needed by its synchronous lineage lookups, and keep numeric issue identity separate from opaque branch authority. Preserve canonical `feature/epic/<N>` fallback only when the parent has no recorded branch, and propagate malformed or ambiguous branch authority and missing required graph nodes as fail-closed errors before any Git mutation.
